strategic_transaction_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: eh260792115_ex9901.htm
strategic_transaction_evidence.claim: Eaton agreed to separate and combine its Mobility Group with Dana in a Reverse Morris Trust, creating a combined company valued at more than $10 billion while shifting Eaton toward Electrical and Aerospace.
strategic_transaction_evidence.summary: RMT transaction advances Eaton's portfolio transformation away from Mobility and toward core Electrical and Aerospace businesses.
strategic_transaction_evidence.excerpt: Eaton entered into a definitive agreement with Dana Incorporated (NYSE: DAN) under which Eaton will separate and combine its Mobility Group with Dana in a Reverse Morris Trust (RMT) transaction creating a combined company valued at over $10 billion.
strategic_transaction_evidence.notes: Classified as strategic transaction because merger/acquisition/divestiture/RMT/deal terms dominate the document.

strategic_transaction_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: eh260792115_ex9901.htm
strategic_transaction_evidence.claim: Management says the Mobility separation will make Eaton more focused on Electrical and Aerospace businesses tied to secular growth themes including electrification, AI data centers, infrastructure, aerospace aftermarket, and defense.
strategic_transaction_evidence.summary: Deal rationale is to increase Eaton's exposure to higher-growth Electrical and Aerospace secular themes.
strategic_transaction_evidence.excerpt: Upon closing of the transaction, Eaton will operate a more focused portfolio concentrated on its Electrical and Aerospace businesses, which are directly aligned to secular growth themes in electrification, digitalization, AI-driven data center buildout, infrastructure modernization, aerospace aftermarket, and defense spending.
strategic_transaction_evidence.notes: Classified as strategic transaction because merger/acquisition/divestiture/RMT/deal terms dominate the document.

strategic_transaction_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: eh260792115_ex9901.htm
strategic_transaction_evidence.claim: Eaton expects the Mobility separation to be immediately accretive to its organic growth rate and operating margins when it closes.
strategic_transaction_evidence.summary: Management frames the transaction as enhancing Eaton's growth and margin profile.
strategic_transaction_evidence.excerpt: The separation is expected to be immediately accretive to Eaton’s organic growth rate and operating margins upon closing.
strategic_transaction_evidence.notes: Classified as strategic transaction because merger/acquisition/divestiture/RMT/deal terms dominate the document.

strategic_transaction_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: eh260792115_ex9901.htm
strategic_transaction_evidence.claim: Eaton will receive about $1.1 billion of cash from the transaction and expects to deploy it under its existing capital allocation framework, including debt repayment.
strategic_transaction_evidence.summary: Transaction proceeds provide cash that may support deleveraging or reinvestment priorities.
strategic_transaction_evidence.excerpt: Eaton expects to deploy the approximately $1.1 billion cash distribution from the transaction consistent with its existing capital allocation framework and priorities, including repayment of outstanding indebtedness.
strategic_transaction_evidence.notes: Classified as strategic transaction because merger/acquisition/divestiture/RMT/deal terms dominate the document.

strategic_transaction_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: eh260792115_ex9901.htm
strategic_transaction_evidence.claim: The combined Mobility/Dana company expects approximately $11 billion of pro forma revenue, $1.7 billion of estimated 2026 adjusted EBITDA including synergies, and $250 million of run-rate cost synergies fully realized within 24 months after closing.
strategic_transaction_evidence.summary: The transaction includes sizable expected revenue, EBITDA, and synergy targets for the combined company.
strategic_transaction_evidence.excerpt: The combined company expects to generate approximately $11 billion in pro forma revenue and $1.7 billion in pro forma estimated 2026 adjusted EBITDA (including run-rate synergies, which are expected to be fully realized within 24 months following closing). The combined company will benefit from increased scale, $250 million of run-rate cost synergies, and greater diversification across customers, geographies, and end markets.
strategic_transaction_evidence.notes: Classified as strategic transaction because merger/acquisition/divestiture/RMT/deal terms dominate the document.

strategic_transaction_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: eh260792115_ex9901.htm
strategic_transaction_evidence.claim: The transaction values Eaton's Mobility Group at about $5.1 billion, equal to 8.3x 2026 estimated pro forma adjusted EBITDA or 5.9x including run-rate synergies.
strategic_transaction_evidence.summary: Deal terms provide valuation and EBITDA multiple benchmarks for the Mobility separation.
strategic_transaction_evidence.excerpt: The transaction values Eaton’s Mobility Group at approximately $5.1 billion. This represents a multiple of 8.3x 2026 estimated pro forma adjusted EBITDA, or 5.9x on a fully synergized basis, including $250 million of run-rate synergies.
strategic_transaction_evidence.notes: Classified as strategic transaction because merger/acquisition/divestiture/RMT/deal terms dominate the document.

strategic_transaction_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: eh260792115_ex9901.htm
strategic_transaction_evidence.claim: Eaton shareholders will own at least 50.1% of the combined company after the Mobility/Dana transaction.
strategic_transaction_evidence.summary: Eaton shareholders retain majority economic participation in the new combined Mobility/Dana entity.
strategic_transaction_evidence.excerpt: Eaton shareholders will receive newly issued shares of the combined company such that Eaton shareholders will own at least 50.1% of the combined company’s outstanding shares following the consummation of the transaction.
strategic_transaction_evidence.notes: Classified as strategic transaction because merger/acquisition/divestiture/RMT/deal terms dominate the document.

strategic_transaction_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: eh260792115_ex9901.htm
strategic_transaction_evidence.claim: The deal is expected to close in Q1 2027, but remains subject to Dana shareholder approval, required regulatory clearances, and customary closing conditions.
strategic_transaction_evidence.summary: The transaction has a defined expected timeline but remains conditional on approvals and clearances.
strategic_transaction_evidence.excerpt: The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to receipt of Dana shareholder approval, receipt of required regulatory clearances, and customary closing conditions.
strategic_transaction_evidence.notes: Classified as strategic transaction because merger/acquisition/divestiture/RMT/deal terms dominate the document.

strategic_transaction_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: etn03312026exhibit99.htm
strategic_transaction_evidence.claim: Eaton reported record Q1 2026 sales of $7.5 billion, up 17% year over year, with 10% organic sales growth above guidance; adjusted EPS was a first-quarter record $2.81.
strategic_transaction_evidence.summary: Q1 results showed strong sales and organic growth with record adjusted EPS.
strategic_transaction_evidence.excerpt: Eaton Corporation plc (NYSE:ETN) today announced that first quarter 2026 earnings per share were $2.22. Excluding charges of $0.29 per share related to intangible amortization, $0.22 per share related to acquisitions and divestitures, and $0.08 per share related to a multi-year restructuring program, adjusted earnings per share were $2.81, a first quarter record. Sales in the quarter were $7.5 billion, a record and up 17% from the first quarter of 2025. The sales increase consisted of 10% growth in organic sales, 4% growth from acquisitions and 3% growth from foreign exchange.
strategic_transaction_evidence.notes: Source document_purpose is strategic_transaction, though the exhibit text includes quarterly results.
